description: This Java class functions as a Spring MVC controller managing user registration. It provides endpoints for displaying a registration form and processing user registration submissions, utilizing a UserService to handle business logic.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling user registration endpoints.

methods.name: newUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the user registration form.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process user registration with UserDto data and manages success or error flow.
